blocks.text: Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: The monthly market report I use covers North Delta only, not Ladner or Tsawwassen, so there are no figures for Cliff Drive, and North Delta's numbers don't apply here.

Recreation: Brandrith Park (5093 12 Avenue), with pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts and washrooms; South Delta Recreation Centre (1720 56 Street); and Tsawwassen Library (1321A 56 Street) at Tsawwassen Town Centre.
Hazard Development Permit Area SD2: the OCP's hazard DPAs in Tsawwassen include SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), immediately west of this pocket.

There is no separate Tsawwassen Area Plan to consult for this pocket: the current consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), has a single Land Use Plan. City reports and listings that predate July 2024 may refer to the earlier area plans; read them against the current OCP.
Brandrith Park is the pocket's park, at 5093 12 Ave — listed by the City with pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts and washrooms.

The escarpment permit area starts at the area's western edge. English Bluff (the Tsawwassen Escarpment) is a hazard development permit area under the Official Community Plan, which matters on the English Bluff Road side and isn't something listings mention.

blocks.text: Where the townhomes are and what to know

items.t: Transit: route 601 runs South Delta / Boundary Bay to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via 56 Street and South Delta Exchange; route 602 runs Tsawwassen Heights to Bridgeport Station via South Delta Exchange, at 56 Street and 18 Avenue beside South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St.
Schools: SD37 catchments are address-based, elementary K–7 and secondary 8–12 with no middle-school tier.
None of Delta's five 55+ complexes is townhouses.

Delta's flood system is city-wide, not pocket-specific: over 63 kilometres of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, 31 drainage pump stations and roughly 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure, maintained by the City as diking authority — lot-level flood construction requirements still have to be checked parcel by parcel.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Cliff Drive

items.t: Lots here are fee simple: mostly single detached houses in the RS zones around 12 Avenue and English Bluff Road, with duplexes where the RD zones apply; check a specific lot on the City's zoning maps. A Cliff Drive property sells as a whole house, lot and zone, not as a serviced lot in a subdivision.

Minimum sizes for new lots: RS4 610 m², RS5 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 390 m², RS7 335 m², RD1 836 m² and RD4 504 m², while RS1, RS2, RS3, RD2 and RD3 are 4,000 m². Existing lots vary, so check a specific property.
The Garden Place NWS1841 units are built strata, not bare-land strata, and sit outside the pocket as defined — see the OPEN flag at the top.
ALR vs non-ALR split: A specific parcel's ALR status is checked in the ALC's ALR Property and Map Finder and on title.
Hazard edge: the OCP's hazard Development Permit Areas in Tsawwassen include SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), immediately west of this pocket.
The City is the diking authority and operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure.

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta, BC. Cliff Drive sits inside the Tsawwassen community — one of Delta's three communities (Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta), with Ladner and Tsawwassen together called South Delta — planned under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024).

Some listing sources give the subdivision name Cliff Drive to units at 1440 and 1441 Garden Place ("The Camelia" and "Magnolia", strata plan NWS1841, built 1982). Those addresses are near Tsawwassen's town centre and Winskill, outside the Cliff Drive area described here, and sources disagree.

Schools are SD37 and address-based, K–7 elementary and 8–12 secondary with no middle-school tier. The recorded sample result for 1299 56 St — at the pocket's eastern edge, not binding the whole pocket. are used here: Cliff Drive Elementary; South Delta Secondary.

Recreation and transit: Brandrith Park (5093 12 Avenue), with pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts and washrooms; South Delta Recreation Centre (1720 56 Street); and Tsawwassen Library (1321A 56 Street). Route 601 runs from South Delta and Boundary Bay to Bridgeport Station via 56 Street and South Delta Exchange (56 Street and 18 Avenue), and route 602 from Tsawwassen Heights to Bridgeport Station via the exchange.

I don't know of any bare-land strata lots in Cliff Drive. If you bought one, BC strata rules would apply to the lot: the Form B (fees, contingency reserve balance, levies, insurance, rules, budget and depreciation report) within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page; a depreciation report every 5 years for stratas with 5 or more lots; at least 10% of the budget into the reserve; no rental bans; and only 55+ age bylaws, so a "45+" listing line isn't enforceable.
The anchor school sits inside the pocket; the sample catchment sits at its edge. Cliff Drive Elementary is physically at 5025 12 Ave.

The escarpment is immediately west, not inside the sales pitch. SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment) is the OCP's hazard DPA for the shore west of this pocket; which Cliff Drive parcels fall inside it is a map read, not a neighbourhood assumption.
